title: Reaction-wheel pendulum — physical balance experiment, final nominal two-second export
creator: gvp-study (upstream repository owner)

history.key_normalization: Unicode NFKD, casefold, alphanumeric characters; DOI, repository, distinctive title and older release aliases as applicable.

rights: Public GitHub repository. GitHub repository metadata reports licence=null and the fixed tree has no LICENSE/COPYING file. Reuse permission for upstream data/code/media is undetermined. Only new aggregate counts, source links and a separately written analysis routine are included; no upstream data, firmware, graphics or photographs are redistributed.
search: Followed the gvp-study/reaction-wheel-pendulum candidate from the R2 control-bench search. Checked fixed repository tree, README, data history and acquisition code rather than inferring channels from filenames.
https://api.github.com/repos/gvp-study/reaction-wheel-pendulum/commits?path=data&per_page=100 showed one commit affecting the data/ path, a9cc690baa54d06579a0758f04991ea89bea9ee8.
hardware: Single physical bar, reaction wheel, encoder and AS5048A PWM angle sensor, STM32G431 FOC controller. README section 9 links the 126 s physical balance with a deliberate final push, firmware v3.6, gain 0.85, nominal 12 V supply limited at 3 A, command limit +/−6 V. The accompanying fit_closed_loop.py identifies balance.csv as the final nominal 2 s of that run.
time_and_commands: Firmware esc1_balance.ino lines 281–295 computes a state feedback voltage request, clips to ±U_MAX, then limits the change to ±0.3 V per control update. Only the post-limiter state u is stored, rounded to millivolts. Telemetry records every other active update in a 1,000-row ring. Lines 214–224 print t_ms = 2 × export slot and loop() can resynchronize after missing ticks. Adjacent 2 ms labels denote nominal spacing, not measured wall-clock interval. motor.move(u) is sent through the separate FOC loop. Bus voltage is sampled separately.
cleaning: Verify end-of-export marker, exact nominal slot sequence, row count and field types. Aggregate disjoint same-polarity endpoint intervals in recorded millivolts, adjacent finite differences in these integer units, and bus/encoder extrema. An interval including the last row is censored at export end.
interpretation: The observed +6.000 V rows reach the recorded command endpoint at 1 mV output precision. No row reaches −6 V. A change of exactly 600 mV across two saved slots is consistent with the slew bound on two consecutive 1 kHz updates within rounding. Neither the pre-clipping request nor the intervening 1 ms sample is logged. The bus voltage is not the applied motor phase voltage and the 3 A supply setting is not measured current. No anti-windup comparator or independent standard of torque is supplied.
reproduce: Python 3: download data/balance.csv at the fixed URL in sources, then python derive_reaction_wheel.py balance.csv OUT.
